summary: Change a renderer's colour or float at runtime without instancing a material.
overview: Wraps MaterialPropertyBlock so you can tweak a renderer's properties at runtime without creating a new Material — which leaks unless cleaned up manually, and breaks batching. Drop it on any Renderer and set properties; the block is applied for you.
useCases: Tinting each enemy in a crowd differently from one material.
A damage flash that does not instance a material per hit.
Per-instance variation without an asset per variant.

gotchas.title: It changes this renderer only
gotchas.body: That is the point, and it means it is not a way to change the material for everything sharing it.

gotchas.title: It initialises lazily, because Awake is not reliable outside Play mode
gotchas.body: It uses the toolkit's EnsureInitialized pattern so it works from an editor script or a self-test too.
